description: Use when the user wants to look through the journeys, optionally within one category (a slug from list_journey_categories). Returns a page of the same cards as find_journey, with the total and next_offset.

category.description: A category slug from list_journey_categories (e.g. education). Omit for every category.

offset.description: Start position; pass next_offset from the previous page.

name: browse_journeys
title: Browse journeys

description: Use when the user asks for a summary to keep. Composes a markdown takeaway from this journey session: what the user asked, the key points and the stops visited. Available on connected accounts; otherwise returns not_available.

session.description: The session handle from open_journey (starts with cxs_).

template_id.description: Required for kind template: an id from capabilities.templates.

name: create_takeaway
title: Create a takeaway

description: Use when the user wants a guided, step-by-step journey on a topic, a skill or an exam. Searches the published journeys and returns up to three cards (id, title, summary, shape, languages, number of stops, estimated minutes, who it is for and not for, a premium flag, page_url). `in_progress: true` marks a journey this user already has open. When nothing matches, `alternatives` holds the three nearest journeys.

locale.description: The user's locale (en, fr, es, ar).

query.description: The topic, skill or exam to search for, in a few words. The topic only, no personal details.

name: find_journey
title: Find a guided journey

description: Use when the user asks where they are in a journey, how far they have come or how much is left. Returns the current stop, visited and remaining stops, percent done, practice stats, limits and a resume line.

session.description: The session handle from open_journey (starts with cxs_).

name: get_journey_progress
title: Get journey progress

description: Use when the user wants to continue the journey later, on the website or in another assistant. Returns a resume link and a short resume code for this session.

session.description: The session handle from open_journey (starts with cxs_).

name: get_resume_link
title: Get a resume link

description: Use when the user asks what kinds of journeys are available. Returns each category slug, a readable label, the number of journeys in it and a few example titles.
name: list_journey_categories
title: List journey categories

description: Use when the user chooses a journey to start or continue. Opens it, or resumes the user's session for it, and returns the session contract: `session`, the stop titles, the capabilities, the limits in turns and the first step. Calling it again for the same journey resumes the same session; it never resets progress.

capsule_id.description: The journey id from find_journey (uuid or short id). `welcome` opens the sandbox tour.

goal.description: What the user wants from the journey, in a few words, if they said. No personal details.

locale.description: Preferred locale; the beat echoes the locale actually served.

slug.description: The journey slug, when you hold that instead of the id.

name: open_journey
title: Open a journey

description: Use only when the user explicitly asks to start a journey over, after confirming with them. Returns to the first step and clears the visited stops; turns already used stay used. Returns the same session contract as open_journey.

capsule_id.description: The journey id (uuid or short id).

slug.description: The journey slug, when you hold that instead of the id.

name: restart_journey
title: Restart a journey

description: Use for every step after open_journey. Sends the user's choice and returns the next step: `answer`, `statement`, numbered `options` with ids, `media`, `progress` and `limits`. Send `pick` with an option id when the user chose an option or its number; otherwise send `say` with what the user said. `go` jumps to a stop from the contract; `drill` and `simulate` start practice on exam journeys; `exit` leaves practice. Supply a fresh `turn_id` per step; a repeat returns the stored step. If the step carries `wall`, tell the user `wall.for_human`.

option.description: An option id from the LAST beat.

said.description: What else the user said about this step, when they said more than the option. No personal details.

text.description: What the user said in reply to this step. No personal details.

node.description: A stop id from the contract's toc.

session.description: The session handle from open_journey (starts with cxs_).

turn_id.description: Your idempotency id for this step (fresh per step).

name: take_journey_step
title: Take a journey step
